title: Outpatient Evidence-to-Practice Apply Gate
purpose: Block any outpatient clinical recommendation from being treated as actionable unless the evidence, safety, local feasibility, follow-up, and doctor approval controls are all documented.
release_rule: release_state='approved_for_use' is forbidden unless every required control in outpatient_apply_review is satisfied, guardrail_result='PASS', and audit_trail.human_approval_id is present.

conditional_controls.why: Drug recommendations in outpatient care must check interactions, renal/hepatic function, pregnancy/elderly risks, monitoring, and local availability.
Material guideline/evidence conflicts require explicit doctor/shared decision review before action.
Formulary, BHYT, resource, or referral-pathway uncertainty cannot be silently converted into an actionable recommendation.

outpatient_apply_review_fields.strict_source_gate_passed: true only after online/strict source verification for all evidence items or an equivalent documented source-integrity review.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.evidence_currency_checked: true only when source date/version and recency are documented.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.absolute_effects_status: reported / not_applicable / source_not_reported_labeled — ARR/NNT/NNH or LR/absolute risk must be reported when the source provides it; otherwise label the gap.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.red_flag_screen_done: true after must-not-miss and transfer/referral red flags are screened.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.safety_review_done: true after contraindications, interactions, monitoring, and harm alerts are reviewed.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.medication_recommendation_present: true if any medication is recommended, changed, stopped, or monitored.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.medication_safety_checked: true after drug interaction, renal, hepatic, pregnancy, elderly/frailty and monitoring checks relevant to that medication are complete.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.organ_function_checked: true after renal/hepatic function is confirmed or explicitly marked as required before prescribing.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.special_population_checked: true after older adult/frailty/pregnancy/CKD/liver disease/polypharmacy considerations are addressed or marked not applicable.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.local_feasibility_checked: true after Vietnam outpatient feasibility, formulary/BHYT/resource/referral constraints are reviewed.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.shared_decision_ready: true when benefit-harm-cost-preference language is ready for doctor-patient discussion.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.safety_netting_present: true when return precautions use 'đến cơ sở y tế gần nhất' and do not delay urgent care.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.follow_up_plan_present: true when follow-up timing and monitoring outcomes are stated.
outpatient_apply_review_fields.doctor_final_approval_required: must be true; AI may prepare but cannot apply the recommendation by itself.

blocked_release_reasons: Prompt injection detected in retrieved evidence
Material conflicting evidence not resolved by doctor/shared decision
